classification_scale.NOT_EXPOSED: The task does not enter the latent dynamic or the relevant action/resource is absent.
classification_scale.EXPOSED_NONCRITICAL: The dynamic occurs, but task success does not depend on handling its downstream consequence.
classification_scale.EXPOSED_CRITICAL: A reasonable completion path requires handling the latent dependency; ignoring it can change the evaluator-required outcome.

phenomena.name: Retail Item-Mutation Transition Dependency
phenomena.semantic_chain: modify_pending_order_items appends a settlement entry and changes order status; a later payment replacement requires exactly one payment entry, while later cancellation requires status exactly pending.

phenomena.name: Airline Preserved-Segment Historical Valuation
phenomena.semantic_chain: A segment with matching flight number/date and unchanged cabin retains its stored reservation price instead of the current catalog price; the retained basis can change a transaction threshold or branch.

phenomena.name: Retail Cancellation Refund Resource State
phenomena.semantic_chain: Cancelling a gift-card-funded pending order credits the profile gift-card balance; a later transaction can depend on the replenished resource.

phenomena.name: Airline Certificate Lifecycle and Cross-Transaction Coupling
phenomena.semantic_chain: A successful booking removes the entire certificate from the user's payment methods regardless of allocated amount; a later booking cannot reuse any nominal remainder.

phenomena.name: Airline Flight-Change Settlement Baseline
phenomena.semantic_chain: Flight-update settlement prices the complete submitted itinerary using historical/current segment rules, multiplies by stored passenger count, and subtracts the stored old flight-segment total; branch thresholds can depend on this delta rather than gross replacement fare or total payment history.
phenomena.addition_reason: This phenomenon was added from the reviewed registry and backend formula because three frozen task specifications branch on the flight-change transaction delta. No rollout outcome was consulted.

phenomena.name: Airline Flight-Change and Cancellation Non-Enforcement
phenomena.semantic_chain: Mutation APIs omit enforcement of stated eligibility rules. This affects policy compliance interpretation more directly than successful completion of eligible frozen tasks.
